hooks.command: p=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$p" | grep -qiE '\.(tsx|jsx|vue|svelte|css|scss)$'; then echo "[vibelens] Edited $p. This frontend change is unverified until you re-run inspect_localhost_ui on the affected page with the same url, viewport, fullPage and delay as the previous capture."; fi; exit 0

p=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); echo "$p" | grep -qiE '\.(tsx|jsx|vue|svelte|css|scss)$' && grep -qE '#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}|rgba?\(|[a-z]-\[[.#0-9]' "$p" 2>/dev/null && echo "[vibelens] Raw values found in $p (six-digit hex, rgb()/rgba(), or arbitrary bracket utilities like text-[13px]) — prefer a semantic colour token or a step on the type/spacing scale."; exit 0
